Title: Page not found error page shows its heading
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/ErrorPageNotFound.aspx.
Step Expected: The page loads and the address path is /ErrorPageNotFound.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Page not found.

Step Action: Reload the page.
Step Expected: The h1 still reads Page not found.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No unhandled server error page is shown; only the Page not found page is displayed.

Title: Unknown route returns HTTP 404
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/DoesNotExist.aspx.
Step Expected: The server responds with HTTP status 404.

Step Action: Check the response status code in the browser developer tools network tab.
Step Expected: The status code for /DoesNotExist.aspx is 404 and not 200 or 500.

Step Action: Check the page content for a server error message.
Step Expected: No HTTP 500 server error page is shown.

Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx again.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing, so the site still works after the 404.
